title: East Nashville 2BR 3BA Near Downtown King Beds
description:
This superbly style brand new duplex makes for a perfect luxurious getaway. With 2 king bed, 2 twin day beds and 2.5 bathrooms, it's absolutely ideal for groups of friends & family looking for a convenient location in Nashville. Perfect if you want to be close to the hustle and bustle of Nashville but not right in the middle of it. Excellent for people looking for an exquisite Nashville home. Comfortable and stylish. We love to go that extra mile so you feel like you are at home.

The space
This astounding home has everything you need for a fully facilitated stay. Overall this home is furnished to an immaculate standard. It’s the ideal retreat for a secluded & comfortable stay, located very close to the airport as well as downtown Nashville. Very close to some fabulous sites. All in all, guaranteed enjoyment and relaxation. All day long.

Guest access
You will have access to the entire unit

Other things to note
There are two units in the property, please be respectful with guests in the other property.
